## What changed

Describe the business problem and the implementation added or changed.

## Validation

- [ ] Python files pass `python scripts/validate_portfolio.py`
- [ ] n8n workflows parse and contain nodes and connections
- [ ] SQL schemas include the required tables
- [ ] No credentials, client-confidential data, or generated files are committed
- [ ] Deployment context is labeled accurately as client work or a reference scenario
- [ ] SOP and build documentation reflect the implementation

## Operational review

- [ ] Trigger scope and volume assumptions are documented
- [ ] Retries, idempotency, and failure handling are covered
- [ ] Monitoring, cost controls, and a safe pause path are documented
